# Capacities UI
React 19 + TypeScript + scoped CSS; React peers only, no runtime dependencies.

Read narrowly:
- AGENTS.md — development and consumer invariants.
- agent-manifest.json — only selected component records: exact props, defaults, variants, keyboard behavior, examples and related.
- docs/component-guidelines.md — component choice, composition, behavior, content and catalogue maintenance.
- docs/surface-context.md — semantic paint, independent context axes and CSS/Figma graph.
- docs/recipes.md — working compositions; examples/ProjectBoard.tsx and examples/WorkspaceV2.tsx are executable examples.
- DESIGN.md — typography and visual language.
- docs/instructions/*.md — optional project-specific instructions created in the local editor.

These six core files form the canonical instructions; avoid loading all at once. docs/reference/ retains historical implementation detail for targeted audit, not normal onboarding. source/loaded-stylesheets.json, source token catalogs, source-tokens.css and versions/ are provenance/rollback evidence; do not load them for routine UI work.

Import { Button, Tag, Dialog, ScrollArea } from '@personal/capacities-ui';
Import '@personal/capacities-ui/styles.css' once. Fonts are opt-in via fonts.css.
Set data-theme on html; theme/accent/surface/borders/radius/shadow inherit independently. Paint custom surfaces using --cap-surface-current. Portals preserve nearest context and establish floating.

npm run dev — local catalogue at http://127.0.0.1:4317. #ComponentName routes are case-sensitive. #agents edits real core/custom files with revision checks; production build is read-only.
npm run check — tokens, manifest, types, tests, package and demo build.
npm run pack:kit and npm run verify:package — package validation.
docs/verification.md records actual checks; CHANGELOG.md records release changes. Generated exports do not prove a live Figma update or deployment. Frozen versions/v0.2.0 and versions/v0.1.0 are never overwritten.
